mapper.sql: select h.health_id, h.pet_id, h.archive_no, h.vaccine_name, h.vaccine_progress, h.vaccine_date, h.deworm_name, h.deworm_date, h.exam_items, h.exam_result, h.exam_date, h.exam_hospital, h.genetic_screen, h.health_level, h.health_note, h.source_channel, h.source_place, h.father_info, h.mother_info, h.birth_date, h.is_photo_real, h.temperament, h.feed_plan, h.care_points, h.skill_level, h.guarantee_days, h.contract_no, h.delivery_support, h.aftersale_note, h.status, h.del_flag, h.create_by, h.create_time, h.update_by, h.update_time, h.remark, p.pet_name as pet_name, p.breed as breed, p.image as image, p.category_id as category_id, p.price as price from pet_health h left join pet_info p on p.pet_id = h.pet_id
